acceptedAnswer.text: The construction timeline for a pergola typically ranges from a few days for a pre-fabricated kit to several weeks for a custom-built structure, depending on its size and complexity. Factors such as weather conditions, material availability, and the need for ground preparation can also influence the project duration.
